name: wiki
description: Knowledge pages like in Notion: a page tree, Markdown, full-text search and a history of every change. For humans and agents alike.

requiredTables.name: pages
requiredTables.description: Wiki pages: title, Markdown content, tags, parent page, archive timestamp and a full-text index (Postgres English dictionary).

requiredTables.name: page_revisions
requiredTables.description: History: the state of every page after every change, with author (human or agent) and timestamp. Never modified.

offeredTools.name: pages.list
offeredTools.description: Lists wiki pages without content, sorted by title, never archived ones. Arguments, all optional: q = text that must appear in the title; parentId = UUID, only direct subpages of that page; tag = only pages with this tag. Returns {pages: [{id, parentId, title, tags, updatedAt, updatedBy}], truncated}. truncated=true means more than 500 pages; narrow the filter. To search the content use pages.search, for the text use pages.get.

offeredTools.name: pages.get
offeredTools.description: Reads a page in full. Argument: id (UUID from pages.list or pages.search). Returns {id, parentId, title, contentMd (Markdown), tags, createdAt, createdBy, updatedAt, updatedBy, archivedAt (null or timestamp), parent ({id, title} or null), children ([{id, title}], non-archived subpages)}. Unknown id: error 404.

offeredTools.name: pages.search
offeredTools.description: Full-text search in title and content of non-archived pages, Postgres English dictionary: English word forms match (request finds requests), other languages only exactly, stop words like the are ignored. Arguments: query (search text; "exact phrase", -word excludes, or combines), limit (optional, 1 to 50, default 10). Returns {hits: [{id, parentId, title, tags, updatedAt, rank, snippet}]}, best hit first; snippet is a one-line excerpt with hits in «…». Fetch the full text with pages.get.

offeredTools.name: pages.create
offeredTools.description: Creates a new page and writes the first history entry. Arguments: title (1 to 200 characters), contentMd (Markdown, may be empty), parentId (optional, UUID of a non-archived page; the new page becomes its subpage), tags (optional, list of short words, at most 20). Returns the new page like pages.get. Check with pages.search first whether the page already exists.

offeredTools.name: pages.update
offeredTools.description: Changes a page and writes a history entry with you as the author. Arguments: id, plus at least one of: title; contentMd (replaces the whole content); appendMd (appends Markdown at the end after a blank line, the rest stays; not together with contentMd); tags (replaces all tags). To add to a page use appendMd instead of rewriting the content. Returns the page like pages.get. Archived pages: error 400.

offeredTools.name: pages.archive
offeredTools.description: Archives a page: it disappears from pages.list and pages.search and stays readable with pages.get and pages.history. Cannot be undone through the tools. Argument: id. If the page has non-archived subpages, you get error 400 with their names; archive the subpages first. Returns {id, archivedAt}. Archiving again changes nothing.

offeredTools.name: pages.history
offeredTools.description: History of a page, newest change first, also for archived pages. Arguments: id, limit (optional, 1 to 200, default 50). Returns {pageId, title, revisions: [{id, change (create, update or archive), title, contentMd, tags, editedBy, editedAt}]}. Each revision is the state after the change; editedBy is a person id or agent:<name>.

requestedGrants.reason: Who may open the wiki. Which group is decided by the grant in the control plane; a requested right is a request, not an assignment.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Connection to the app's own schema, using the app role. Set by the control plane.

env.name: DATABASE_SCHEMA
env.description: The app's own schema. The SDK derives the search_path from it; a DSN with options= is rejected.

env.name: OPENAPPS_AUTH_SECRET
env.description: App-specific secret the SDK uses to verify the gateway signature. Set by the control plane per deployment.

env.name: OPENAPPS_APP_ID
env.description: Id of this app in the signed material. Must be byte-identical to what the gateway writes.

env.name: OPENAPPS_APP_HOST
env.description: Shared domain in the signed material, trimmed and lowercased.

env.name: OPENAPPS_APP_BASE_PATH
env.description: Path the app lives under (/wiki). Must be set at build time, otherwise links and images point nowhere.
